Review pauses, provisioning and ancillary storage/transfer/operations excluded from compute mean; failed policy-transition deployment/Mac/pilots remain separate.
forecast.scenario_note: Pending plan not frozen at audit. Historical panel mean is the arithmetic reference; recent larger panels and 1,787 selected base roots motivate an additional planning scenario, not a cap or statistical interval. Update after actual plan admission.

calendar_estimate.final_independently_reviewed_diagnosis: Friday night–Saturday morning, approximately Friday 23:00–Saturday 03:00 centrally with morning allowance for extended review
calendar_estimate.basis: Only final deep analysis, any distinct alternatives and review remain. Historical mean panel time is reported separately. The final base has more selected roots than earlier batches, and no final plan count is known yet, so use a 1–2 hour cloud scenario plus 1–2 hours for preparation/retrieval/review. Final synthesis and independent challenge require a further assumed 2–4 hours. These are assumptions, not guarantees; update from the admitted plan.
calendar_estimate.uncertainty: Regional capacity, more consequential roots, new alternatives or substantive final-review findings can extend the windows. No scientific coverage is truncated.
